title: Trump’s Top Gaza Official Says Israel Is Jeopardizing the Cease-Fire
summary_full: Nickolay Mladenov, the Board of Peace’s high representative for Gaza, criticized Israel for its ongoing strikes on what it says are Hamas targets, after it rejected a plan to disarm the group.
